system.description: During your first turn in a conflict, or when you guard without granting cover, spend 10 MP to become hidden until the end of your next turn. While hidden you cannot be targeted by sight-based ranged attacks or spells (but area effects still hit), and your dagger, spear, or thrown attacks gain +(SL) Accuracy; on a hit such an attack ignores Resistances and you stop being hidden.
